findings.reason: a node that follows this chain edits the picker skip in `dispatch.py`, which every deterministic dispatch shares, instead of the join that made §51's review resolve off the local lane, and its done-when could pass while the actual condition stays unfixed.
findings.text: the section states the fork as `route="deterministic"` setting `deferred_shadow_selection` (`dispatch.py:1259-1266`) so the picker is never asked and the reroute to local cannot happen, but the reflex calls `dispatch(local=on_local_lane, backend_override=...)` (`recovery_review_dispatch.py:2790-2795`) and `is_local` is derived from the resolved backend name (`dispatch.py:1588`), not from the picker; with `on_local_lane` true the request is already local and the allowance hold queues at `dispatch.py:1773` before the 1826 raise is reachable, so the route explains nothing on its own — and the two reviews the plan says the reflex did queue that day ran the same deterministic route

findings.reason: the section's own instruction is to discriminate the unqueued case from the queued ones — the queued ones are its only positive control that the same reflex can queue — so a queued run id that resolves to nothing leaves the node with one control record and no second sample, and it should be replaced by the run that actually queued or the claim dropped.
findings.text: the plan cites "§56's at 07:03Z (`r-20261024T070321553771`)" as one of the two records the deliverable tells the node to "confirm the condition from", but no run directory named `r-20261024T070321553771-*` exists under the crew runs root (the nearest 07:03 entries are `r-20261024T070639663212-review-of-csr-cs-switched-owner-18ad525b2123`), while the 07:25Z id `r-20261024T072532586923-review-of-a-slow-roadmap-read-serves-its-last-snapshot-6a5b1d308c48` does resolve

findings.reason: the reader who greps `queued_run` finds nothing, loses a minute, and reaches the same branch by the `error: lane-paused` text the sentence also quotes; the fix is a word in prose, not a change to what any node would build.

rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — the paragraph's stated mechanism (the deterministic route skips the picker, so the request is never rewritten onto the local lane) cannot produce the observation, because the reflex passes `local=on_local_lane` directly and `dispatch.py:1588` derives `is_local` from the resolved backend, so a deterministic review dispatched on the local lane already reaches the queue branch at `dispatch.py:1773`; the plan's own next sentence names `on_local_lane` as the discriminator, and the two reviews it says queued that same day ran the same `route="deterministic"`, which refutes the route as the cause.
